text: Say - O Messenger - to all people: I am the Messenger of Allah to all of you, not to some of you without others, to Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them, it is not fitting that divinity and worship be for anyone except Him, glorious is His praise, the One able to bring creation into existence, annihilate it, and resurrect it, so believe in Allah and affirm His oneness, and believe in His Messenger Muhammad, peace be upon him, the unlettered Prophet who believes in Allah and what was revealed to him from his Lord and what was revealed to the prophets before him, and follow this Messenger, and commit to acting upon what he commands you of obedience to Allah, hoping that you may be guided to the straight path.
